items.label: Blind
items.title: Blind policy, unseen pegs of the training family
items.text: The policy slides the peg on the plate until it feels the hole, then it drops the peg in. The rare failures do not find the hole in 5 s or push the peg off the plate.

items.label: Blind, extreme size
items.title: Blind policy, extreme part sizes (held out)
items.text: Very small and very large parts. Most failures leave the plate or do not find the hole.

items.label: Blind, random convex
items.title: Blind policy, random convex shapes (held out)
items.text: These shapes have corners that the training pegs do not have. The peg often slips in the grasp or stops partly inside the hole.
